name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Scholarships/Incentives
benefit: - A monthly scholarship of ₹750/- is sanctioned to eligible wards during the currency of the academic year. - The vacation period is excluded from the scholarship disbursement period. - The scholarship is disbursed on a half-yearly basis.
_eligibility_text: ##### ***For the Artist*** - The artist must be a Goan, i.e., born and brought up in Goa. - The artist must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The income of the family of the artist (from all sources) must not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. - The artist must not be less than 50 years in age. (The Government may relax the age criteria for deserving cases under special circumstances.) ##### ***For the Ward of the Artist*** - The ward must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution. - The ward must be pursuing Postgraduate, Degree, or Professional courses. - The ward may be enrolled in educational institutions within the state or outside the state.
